title.zh: ⚡️IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨款1.39亿美元，就此前违反限制增持比特币给予豁免

current_state.zh: The IMF approved a $139 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the country's breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases.
